subject: MAP: data handling & deployment decision standup — PII retention, VPC/on-prem choices
messages:
From: Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@acme-corp.com>
To: rafael.mendes@redwood.ai
Cc: james.liu@cloudvendor.com, monica.patel@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-01T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: MAP kickoff — data handling clarifications before eval

Rafael, team — thanks for the quick turnaround on the MAP. We reviewed the draft and have three outstanding asks before we finalize the evaluation plan:

1) PII scope: we need confirmation of how Redwood will classify masked vs. unhashed PII in logs and whether token-level redaction is supported in both hosted and VPC modes.
2) Retention: Acme's security policy requires a max retention of 30 days for request/response logs in production evals — can you confirm options for short-term retention and snapshot export for audit?
3) Deployment mode: for the initial pilot we prefer VPC peering or private deployment (no public egress). We need a rough timeline for VPC setup and whether on-prem is possible within the pilot window (targeting end-of-Nov close).

Attached is our redlined data requirements doc and a sample dataset extract. Can we confirm decisions by EOD Friday so we can proceed with the eval scheduling?

Thanks —
Aisha
Product Security, Acme AI

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, James Liu <james.liu@cloudvendor.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T10:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — data handling clarifications before eval

Aisha — thanks for the clear asks. Quick status from our side and proposed decisions (short form) so the team can greenlight the eval schedule:

- PII classification & redaction: Redwood supports token-level redaction for request/response logs in both Hosted API (with opt-in redaction) and Redwood Private (VPC/on-prem). For the pilot, we recommend running redaction at ingest in your staging dataset to avoid storing unhashed PII in logs. Monica, see action item below to confirm exact pipeline hooks.

- Retention: we can configure log retention per-tenant. Options:
  • 30-day rolling retention (managed) — default for pilot and easiest to set up.
  • Shorter retention (7/14 days) possible with configuration — will need to confirm audit export behavior.
  • Export snapshots: we can provide encrypted snapshot exports on request; retention of exported snapshots is controlled by Acme.

- Deployment mode & timeline:
  • VPC peering: CloudOps can provision peering and we can deploy Redwood Private in the Acme VPC — target time 7–10 business days after security signoff.
  • On-prem: supported but requires an extra ops window (2–4 weeks) for network & HSM integration — likely outside pilot timeline if we aim to close by end of Nov.

Action items / owners (proposed):
  1) Monica (Redwood) — detail redaction hooks and required dataset labels by 2026-11-03.
  2) James (CloudOps) — confirm VPC peering requirements and prework checklist by 2026-11-04.
  3) Aisha (Acme) — confirm acceptance of 30-day rolling retention for pilot or request shorter window by 2026-11-05.
  4) Rafael — coordinate security call and finalize MAP timelines; propose Thursday 11/3 for a 30-minute check-in.

I'll attach our mapping table (fields -> PII classification) and the redlined PDF for quick reference. If this approach works, we can lock the eval slots and schedule the provisioning.

— Rafael Mendes
Enterprise Account Exec | Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, James Liu <james.liu@cloudvendor.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T13:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — data handling clarifications before eval

Following up with more technical detail on the redaction/retention side (answers for Aisha):

- Redaction: Redwood supports two modes: pre-ingest schema-based redaction (recommended) and post-ingest token masking. Pre-ingest requires labeling fields in your CSVs/Parquet (we map field names -> PII category). I attached a short mapping table (redwood-mapping-table.xlsx) with our recommended field mappings.

- Logs / KV cache: request/response logs and KV cache can be configured to exclude PII. For the pilot, we will disable full request logging for any field mapped as "sensitive" and only log metadata (model, latency, token counts).

- Retention and exports: 30-day rolling retention is straightforward. If Acme requires 7 or 14 days, we can do that but need a signed data processing addendum clarifying audit export responsibilities. Export snapshots are available as encrypted archives delivered to your S3 bucket; we will not retain exported snapshots on Redwood side beyond delivery unless explicitly requested.

- VPC/on-prem notes: VPC peering + Redwood Private -> supports no public egress and uses customer-managed keys (KMS). On-prem is possible but will need an on-site ops window; for pilot timeline, VPC peering is the recommended path.

Actioning Rafael's items:
  • Monica: will send the redaction hook doc + acceptance checklist by 2026-11-03 COB.
  • Dev: please include a note on HSM/KMS compatibility for VPC deployment.

On the MAP timeline: if Acme confirms 30-day retention and signs the DPA, we can provision VPC and schedule eval infra within ~8 business days.

— Monica Patel
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: James Liu <james.liu@cloudvendor.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-01T16:38:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — data handling clarifications before eval

Looping in to confirm operational side. We can provision VPC peering and a dedicated subnet for the pilot. Summary of what we need from Acme to start:

1) CIDR ranges and contact for network owner 
2) Preferred region (us-west-2 listed in MAP — confirm)
3) S3 bucket ARN for encrypted snapshot delivery (if you want exports)

Timeline: once we have the network info and security approval (network ACLs, firewall rules), we can complete peering and handover to Redwood infra in ~5 business days. If Acme accepts the 30-day rolling retention, that removes one blocker.

Next steps: Rafael — can you confirm the 11/3 30-minute sync? Aisha — if you can confirm retention choice today, we can start network prework Monday.

Thanks,
James Liu
CloudOps Inc. — Partner Engineering
